results.description: ROW_NUMBER replaced by RANK, reasoned to be identical because the ORDER BY key (severity, incident_id) is unique within each partition. That reasoning holds only when no two rows are exact duplicates of each other: ROW_NUMBER breaks a tie between two byte-identical rows arbitrarily and keeps exactly one, while RANK assigns both the same rank and keeps both, so rn = 1 returns two rows instead of one. This project's own edge-case generator (which deliberately injects exact duplicate rows, modeling an upstream retry or replay bug) found this during development; it was not designed in as a mutant. See README / ARTICLE for why this is the corpus's most interesting result.
